challenge.method: Read the edition note with allowed positions and the async-block context statement. Check whether the scope would accidentally date IntoFuture support or stabilization of each kind of async context.
challenge.results: The first-edition statement applies to the syntax, with distinct rules for APIs and individual context forms. The list of async contexts is explanatory rather than a claim that each existed in the initial 2018 toolchain.

limitations: Rust edition and compiler release numbers have different scope. The finding makes no claim about the release dates or evolution of named library facilities or async forms.
